verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs describe taking a plain-language prompt and running it as an agent task that analyzes requirements, implements features, fixes bugs, and writes tests, effectively converting natural-language descriptions into scoped implementation work (e.g. agent.run(prompt=...)). Missing for 10: no evidence of explicit task-scoping/planning output shown to the user before execution, and no independent/hands-on validation of how well ambiguous requests are decomposed.
